install: set -euo pipefail; REPO_DIR="$(pwd)"; if [ ! -x "$REPO_DIR/.venv/bin/python" ]; then python3 -m venv "$REPO_DIR/.venv"; fi; "$REPO_DIR/.venv/bin/python" -m pip install --no-input --upgrade pip; "$REPO_DIR/.venv/bin/pip" install --no-input -r "$REPO_DIR/requirements.txt" pytest pytest-asyncio; "$REPO_DIR/.venv/bin/pip" check; if ! "$REPO_DIR/.venv/bin/python" "$REPO_DIR/scripts/verify_airport_database.py" >/dev/null 2>&1; then "$REPO_DIR/.venv/bin/python" "$REPO_DIR/scripts/build_airport_database.py"; "$REPO_DIR/.venv/bin/python" "$REPO_DIR/scripts/verify_airport_database.py"; fi; if command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ ! -x "$HOME/.local/bin/tsx" ]; then mkdir -p "$HOME/.local"; npm install -g --prefix "$HOME/.local" --no-audit --no-fund tsx; fi; touch "$HOME/.bashrc"; sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' "$HOME/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null || true; PATH_LINE="export PATH=\"$REPO_DIR/.venv/bin:\$HOME/.local/bin:\$PATH\""; grep -qxF "$PATH_LINE" "$HOME/.bashrc" || printf '\n%s\n' "$PATH_LINE" >> "$HOME/.bashrc"
